protocol.selection: post-cold old current_5 never/late, bias_only actual false alarm; eligible q and dose[q+39]>0
protocol.metrics: 25 target points; positivity required Mir frequency and nonzero amplitude; CIII finite and outside -10+/-0.01; actual variation is 5-bin range / p95(abs(valid raw q-127:q+25)) >= 0.01, sensitivity 0.001
protocol.corr: maximum absolute Pearson correlation between five bin means and any complete nonconstant core channel; <0.9 is only lack of close single-channel shape, not conditional information or causality
protocol.linear_residual: least-squares fit of 25 target samples after centering against all 8 complete core channels centered and normalized, rcond=1e-6; report residual norm / original centered norm >=0.5. This is fitted on the same packet; no generalization, noise-floor or causality claim.
